title.narrative: Addressing the lack of understanding on the issue of exploitation and unfair deals among the rural young farmers

description.narrative: The pilot project aims to address the exploitation and unfair deals faced by rural young farmers by enhancing their understanding and skills in agricultural practices and financial management. Through a series of targeted activities, including online capacity-building workshops, information sessions with key stakeholders, and a 5-day agricultural on human rights, good agricultural practices, and financial possibilities, the project will educate young farmers on fair trade practices, sustainable farming methods, and climate change adaptation. Other activities include an exhibition in Denmark and phase out. The project will establish networking and support groups to promote community collaboration and the exchange of innovative ideas. The project emphasises gender equality by ensuring equal participation of males and females in all activities. Ultimately, the project aims to create a self-sufficient community of empowered young farmers capable of sustaining the project's outcomes independently.
